name: Semiconductor power switch
summary: A semiconductor power switch controls a power path electronically.
description: A semiconductor power switch controls a power path electronically. Its power terminals and control input belong to different circuits, and off-state leakage or isolation characteristics require product documentation.
readingNotes: Do not interpret the semiconductor off state as a visible mechanical isolation gap.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A solid-state switch is not an isolating disconnector.
